procedure.label: Received a notice or reply
procedure.guidance: Read what the notice or reply asks you to do. Record when you received it and any date it states. Get timely local legal help if a response date is close or unclear.

evidence_plan.heading: Evidence plan
prompts: Which part of the timeline needs independent support?
What already shows that event, and who may lawfully hold another record?

suggestions.title: Notice and delivery record
suggestions.look_for: Keep the entire notice or reply, including attachments, envelope or message headers, and the receipt date.
suggestions.why: The wording and delivery record help establish what was communicated and when.
suggestions.action: Check the original before relying on a date. Take it to an advocate if a response date is close or unclear.

suggestions.title: Product, order and batch
suggestions.look_for: If available, note the seller, order ID, product name, batch, date on the packaging and when it was opened or served.
suggestions.why: These details can distinguish the particular product from a general complaint about a shop or brand.
suggestions.action: Retain copies of your order and any photos you already took. Do not taste or handle suspect food for evidence. Ask the food safety authority about any sample.

suggestions.title: Symptoms and timing
suggestions.look_for: Write down when you ate, when symptoms started, and whether anyone else independently reported symptoms. Keep any relevant treatment records.
suggestions.why: Timing can guide inquiries. It does not by itself establish what caused the illness.
suggestions.action: Seek medical care when needed. Report factual details and let qualified authorities handle formal sampling or testing.

suggestions.title: Original records and an evidence log
suggestions.look_for: Keep records you lawfully have, with their surrounding context. For each item note the related event, who provided it, when you received it, and any transfer.
suggestions.why: The log distinguishes what you observed from what someone later told you and makes it easier to check the source.
suggestions.action: Keep an unchanged original and label working copies. Avoid editing originals, guessing gaps, or sharing evidence publicly.

next_steps: Take the confirmed timeline and evidence list to an appropriate legal professional.
